behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Literal route outranks an earlier parameter/wildcard and only one handler runs.
docDelivery: Segment decoding occurs after splitting and rank precedence includes exact end.
Registration-order tie handling and no-match null result.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Paths begin /; no query, fragment, trailing slash except /, or empty interior segment. Segments contain valid percent encodings. Patterns use literal decoded ASCII segments, :name or terminal *name, unique identifier names. Handlers synchronous.
independence: Integrate literal/parameter/wildcard route precedence and decoded captures with handler invocation.
